story.vex: A missing card, unrevoked. I'll walk in wearing someone else's access. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it started: the missing card is revoked the moment it's reported, and the vault was never just one layer deep. Astro: "A lost credential is an emergency now, not at end of shift."

INCIDENT NOTE
